title: Why Edward Kenway left his wife in AC Black Flag
subject: edward
description:
Would you have left Caroline for the Caribbean? 👇

How a farmer's son from Swansea ended up a pirate wearing a dead Assassin's robes. Spoilers for Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Ubisoft. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Edward Kenway sailed away from his wife, swearing he'd come back rich.
In 1712 the Swansea farmer's son married Caroline Scott against her father's wishes.
Emmett Scott offered him money to disappear. Edward chose privateering instead.
He told Caroline, "I want food that don't make me sick. I want walls that hold back the wind."
By 1715 he was a pirate, and a storm wrecked his ship.
On the beach he killed a wounded Assassin, Duncan Walpole, and took his robes.
Then he sailed for Havana under a dead man's name, to sell secrets he didn't understand.
